newsitem.title: USA: Ascend, networking stocks lead Nasdaq to record.
newsitem.headline: Ascend, networking stocks lead Nasdaq to record.

text.p: Nasdaq shares hit a new record Wednesday led by strength in Ascend Communications Inc that spilled over to the rest of the technology sector, traders said.

The Nasdaq composite index gained 17.38 points or 1.21 percent to close unofficially at 1455.63, which tops the previous record set on June 24. Advancing issues beat decliners 2154 to 2046 on total volume of 636 million shares.
"Ascend led the day and the rest of the networkers followed suit. Techs have been soft, so this was a good boost for them," one trader said.

Ascend, the most active Nasdaq issue, surged more than 12 percent after Merrill Lynch upgraded the stock to accumulate from neutral. 3Com Corp added 3-11/16 to 48-1/8 after Salomon Brothers raised it to buy from hold, saying the computer networking firm was on track to show "above-trend" earnings growth. The American Stock Exchange networking index jumped 3.82 percent to 302.67.

Dell Computer Corp recovered Tuesday's losses, gaining 4-3/4 to 119-1/8 after Montgomery Securities said the company was on track with its second quarter earnings. Intel Corp and Microsoft Corp also showed gains.
